text: The book characterizes ℝ, up to isomorphism, as:
choices: any ordered field with the Archimedean property
the unique algebraically closed field of characteristic 0
explanation: The book states that, up to isomorphism, there is exactly one complete ordered field, and ℝ is it — completeness being the least-upper-bound property. 'The smallest field containing ℤ' is the book's description of ℚ; the algebraically closed field of characteristic 0 (and cardinality |ℝ|) is ℂ; and the Archimedean property alone fails to single out ℝ, since ℚ is also Archimedean yet not complete.
